cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana's Chief Electoral Officer has urged graduates to finish Form-18 registration before the November 6 deadline (Siasat). Graduates in the Mahabubnagar–Rangareddy–Hyderabad and Warangal–Khammam–Nalgonda MLC constituencies must submit a fresh Form-18 for the newly prepared rolls, even if they registered before. Some eligible graduates have reported problems registering (Siasat, Deccan Chronicle); the exact issues were not in the summaries we read. K Kavitha has urged the Election Commission to extend the registration (The Hans India headline). No extension has been announced so far.
